summary.text: Steven Raga is the Assemblymember for District 30 in Queens, which includes Woodside, Elmhurst, East Elmhurst, Maspeth and Jackson Heights.
His official biography cites two decades of public service, including as executive director of Woodside on the Move and chief of staff to Assemblymember Brian Barnwell.

paragraphs.text: Before the Assembly, Raga was Northeast Regional Manager for Policy and Advocacy at the Susan G. Komen Breast Cancer Foundation and Senior Strategist for Multicultural Leadership at AARP, according to his Assembly biography.

He founded Pilipino American Unity for Progress in Woodside and has sat on the boards of the Western Queens Community Land Trust, Queens LGBT Pride and the National Federation of Filipino American Associations.
He served on Queens Community Board 2 and the Queens District Attorney's Advisory Commission for Asian American Affairs.

He is a member of the New York State Advisory Committee to the U.S. Commission on Civil Rights, appointed under President Obama, and has completed fellowships including Coro New York's Immigrant Civic Leadership Program and National Urban Fellows.
